mapper.select:
select aaa.* from (
UNION ALL
) aaa left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl on aaa.entrustStatus=sdl.ITEM_CODE and sdl.DICT_CODE='ENTRUST_STATUS' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST dictps on aaa.PS=dictps.ITEM_CODE and dictps.DICT_CODE='PS' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST dictpriceModel on aaa.priceModel=dictpriceModel.ITEM_CODE and dictps.DICT_CODE='PRICE_MODEL' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST dictaccountspeed on aaa.priceModel=dictaccountspeed.ITEM_CODE and dictps.DICT_CODE='ACCOUNT_SPEED'
order by sdl.ORDER_NO, aaa.entrustId DESC

if.where: aaa.entrustId || '|' || sdl.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || aaa.invManagerId || '|' || aaa.portfolioId || '|' || aaa.portfolioName || '|' || aaa.finprodMarketId || '|' || aaa.finprodAbbr || '|' || aaa.secType1 || '|' || dictps.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || aaa.shareNum || '|' || dictpriceModel.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || aaa.unitPrice || '|' || aaa.allPrice || '|' || aaa.matureYield || '|' || aaa.exerYield || '|' || dictaccountspeed.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || TO_CHAR(aaa.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') || '|' || TO_CHAR(aaa.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') || '|' || aaa.finishAmt || '|' || aaa.transactioncom || '|' || aaa.REMARK || '|' || aaa.counterId || '|' || aaa.parentPortfolioId like '%' || #{vagueQuery} || '%'

mapper.select:
select distinct t2.ITEM_CODE ITEM_CODE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN t1 inner join sys_datadict_list t2 on t2.DICT_CODE = 'EXEC_MODE' and t1.EXERCISE_TYPE = t2.ITEM_CODE where 1=1 and t1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01'
AND t1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
